Tester-process note, not a daemon bug: the pi-envoy extension prepends exactly one `export LEGION_GRANT=…` block to each bash call; if that block gets duplicated in the command text the last (fake) export wins and `legion gh` fails with `Unable to redeem LEGION_GRANT (403)`.
